thread:
Maya: dropped a narrow-width mock for alert rows that adds a compact 'Snooze' badge + a delivery-preview micropanel. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/compact-snooze-preview :eyes:
Elliot: nice work. first thought: pill copy should read 'Snoozed until 16:40' not just 'Snoozed'. expiry time reduces accidental permanent mutes.
Noor: agree. also suggest a tertiary label for long rules: show truncated rule text with `aria-label` containing the full rule. screen readers will get the full context.
Tess: accessibility: any hover-only preview must have a keyboard equivalent. propose a small focusable chevron button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. clicking opens the delivery panel.
Maya: good call. design intent: inline row shows metadata (playbook link, owner, last-run); compact delivery preview shows icons + "Delivering to: #alerts, PagerDuty" and a smaller "via: <rule-name>" line.
Elliot: microcopy tweak: use active voice "Delivering to:" rather than "Will notify:". shorter and clearer.
Noor: a11y details: when the delivery panel loads announce via live region: `aria-live="polite"` text "Delivery preview loaded for alert <short id>". also announce snooze actions: "Alert snoozed until 16:40".
Tess: contrast note: pill foreground must be pure white on dark themes to hit 4.5:1. add focus-visible styles. small CSS example I used: ```css
.compact-pill:focus-visible{ outline: 3px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 2px }
.compact-pill{ background:#2b3746; color:#ffffff }
```
Maya: performance: previews should lazy-load on first focus/hover and cache snippet for 10 minutes. don't hit routing service during list scroll.
Elliot: integration: preview should resolve actual endpoints, not rule names. show humanized channel names plus service identifiers for pager integrations. e.g., "PagerDuty  svc-payments".
Noor: UX question: inline badge vs icon-only badge. icon-only reduces clutter but hides state from quick scans. recommend text when space allows, icon fallback on very dense rows with `aria-label`.
Tess: keyboard flow: when popover opens trap focus and support Escape to close, returning focus to the opener. role=dialog and `aria-modal=true` for the popover.
Maya: i'll update Figma to include the chevron opener, aria annotations, and the short history row "Snoozed by A. Kim  2h ago" in details. sync tomorrow 9am to finalize copy?
Elliot: works for me.
Noor: added. @ops-bot can you schedule and enable recording?
